user.title: Add an Eversolo streamer
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the Eversolo device. It is contacted on port 9529 and needs no username or password.

data_description.host: The address of the streamer on your network, for example 192.168.0.60. Give it a fixed address, or a DHCP reservation, so it does not move.

reconfigure.title: Move an Eversolo streamer to a new address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address or hostname of this Eversolo device. It must be the same physical unit as the one already set up.

data_description.host: The address the streamer answers on now. Its entities and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the server.
error.unsupported_model: That address answered, but the device is not a supported Eversolo DMP model.

abort.already_configured: This Eversolo device is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: That address is a different Eversolo device. Reconfigure only follows the existing device to a new address; to set up a different unit, add it as a new entry.

init.title: Eversolo options
init.description: Everything else in this integration talks only to your Eversolo device.

data.enable_musicbrainz_lookup: Look up cover art for Bluetooth playback

data_description.enable_musicbrainz_lookup: When a Bluetooth track has no cover of its own, look up its artist, title and album on musicbrainz.org and coverartarchive.org to find one. This is the only network traffic this integration sends off your local network, and it is off by default.
